profile_text.body:
Khosla Ventures is a for-profit investment firm founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, United States. Its website describes it as investing in the company best positioned to harness AI's exponential advances to build beneficial, human-aligned intelligence, and it points to tailwinds, proprietary data, and AI talent as the basis for building a broad finance workflow platform. The site also carries commentary on artificial intelligence, including the claim that AI will do 80% of the economically valuable work humans do today, for 80% of all jobs, and a reference to nearly 6 million tons of Lithium discovered in India.

The company's tracked product list is empty, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for it. Its recorded legal exposure is in California, with a count of 281.
